name: B10-0110/2025 (Renew) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Türkiye to stop removing elected mayors from office over politically motivated charges. It wants elected mayors to be allowed to do their jobs, and local councils to pick replacements after a lawful dismissal, until new elections are held. It also asks the European Union's foreign policy chief to consider sanctions on Turkish officials who act as trustees or appoint them.

- The report changes nothing in law; it is a request to Türkiye and the European Union's foreign policy chief.
- It affects dismissed Turkish mayors, local councils, and officials who serve as trustees.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies and Turkish authorities; no action is automatic.
